Jenna - AcmeEvents: Hey team — since ~23:45 UTC we started seeing 429s for our webhook delivery to Redwood. This started after our nightly replay job, looks like ~8k deliveries in 2 minutes.
Maya (support): Sorry you're hitting this, Jenna. Can you paste a sample request id + headers from a failed attempt?
Jenna - AcmeEvents: sure — here's a header block from one of the failed responses:
```
Request-ID: abc123-evt-9001
Status: 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
X-RateLimit-Limit-RPM: 1200
X-RateLimit-Remaining-RPM: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 24
```
Jenna - AcmeEvents: We were sending 60 concurrent streams from each of 6 workers, each worker replays ~200/min — it was a tight burst when the job retried.
Tomas (oncall): @Maya looking — I can see a burst in ingestion in our RPM dashboard from 23:45–23:47 UTC. It exceeded the customer's per-minute cap and hit global token policing, which returned 429s with Retry-After.
rate-limit-bot: Alert: customer_acmeevents exceeded RPM quota (limit=1200 RPM) at 2024-10-08T23:46:03Z. Burst smoothing applied.
Maya (support): Thanks @Jenna and @Tomas. Quick checklist: 1) confirm if your job retries immediately on failure 2) add exponential backoff + jitter 3) limit concurrency per worker to avoid synchronized bursts.
Arjun (ingest-eng): Logs from our edge show KV token exhaustion — we had continuous batching turned off for this route, so each request hit the quota independently. We can enable short-term burst buffer for this tenant (configurable) to absorb small spikes.
Jenna - AcmeEvents: We do retry immediately up to 5 times. We're updating the job now to add randomized backoff. Any advice on config to avoid future hits?
Maya (support): Two options — (A) reduce concurrent streams from 60->10 per worker + add jitter; (B) request a temporary quota bump if you expect sustained high throughput for the replay window. For immediate relief we can enable a per-tenant burst buffer for a few hours (needs eng sign-off).
Tomas (oncall): Also check client-side aggregation: can you batch multiple webhook payloads into one request? That reduces RPM/TPM pressure. For streaming endpoints, reduce chunk size or switch to a single multiplexed connection.
Jenna - AcmeEvents: How do we request a quota bump? We need this replay to finish tonight.
Maya (support): I'll open an internal ticket. @Arjun can you review a temporary burst increase for acmeevents (4x) for 3 hours? We'll monitor unit cost.
Arjun (ingest-eng): On it — flagging to infra. A few notes from our runbook: try to honor Retry-After headers and avoid hammering. If you can share a short list of 10 example Request-IDs, we can map them to our logs and confirm exact rejection reasons.
Jenna - AcmeEvents: Pasting a few IDs: abc123-evt-9001, abc123-evt-9020, abc123-evt-9045, abc123-evt-9100, abc123-evt-9111.
Arjun (ingest-eng): Got them. I see these in the edge logs — they hit per-tenant burst limit at 23:46:12 and were 429'd with Retry-After 12s. Not a system-wide outage, purely quota enforcement.
rate-limit-bot: Action: temporary_burst_buffer enabled for tenant=acmeevents until 2024-10-09T02:00:00Z (by arjun).
Maya (support): Temporary buffer applied. Please hold off aggressive retries and confirm whether your replay slows down. We'll keep monitoring.
Jenna - AcmeEvents: Buffer applied, beginning to throttle our replays from 60->8 concurrent per worker + backoff. Will report progress in 15m. :thumbsup:
Tomas (oncall): We'll track RPM and token burn in the next 30 mins. If you still exceed the buffer, next step is a short scheduled ramp (staggered workers) or a reserved capacity slot (Dedicated) for predictable throughput.
Jenna - AcmeEvents: Quick question — why did the X-RateLimit-Remaining-RPM go to 0 instantly? It felt like a token bucket refilled slowly rather than smoothing bursts.
Arjun (ingest-eng): Good question — for this route the policy is strict per-minute tokens without continuous micro-burst smoothing by default. We can switch to a leaky-bucket profile for webhook ingestion which allows small microbursts without zeroing the remaining count. That requires config change but is safe for a tenant-level change.
Maya (support): Action items: - Support: open internal ticket for quota bump + leaky-bucket profile trial (Maya) - Eng: enable temporary buffer + monitor (Arjun) - Customer: implement jittered backoff and drop immediate retries (Jenna)
Jenna - AcmeEvents: Thanks, team. One more: do you emit headers showing minute-window resets? The X-RateLimit-Reset was "24" in our header — what's that unit?
Arjun (ingest-eng): X-RateLimit-Reset is seconds until the next RPM window (so 24s). We also emit X-RateLimit-WindowStart in logs if you need exact alignment.
Jenna - AcmeEvents: Perfect — we'll use the headers to space retries. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Maya (support): We'll keep the thread updated. Closing loop after 2 hours or when replay is done. If you need an emergency escalation to Dedicated capacity, DM me. :white_check_mark:
